title: Battle controller navigation and melee approaches
summary: Test the native Battle controller flow and corrected default melee approach. Sticks select targets, shoulders cycle legal melee approaches, and A confirms. The default approach now follows the attacking unit's position. Also check the candidate companion's install/verification and return-to-checklist workflow.
preparation: Use a disposable save with battles containing friendly/enemy units, obstacles, ranged and melee units, and a two-wide unit where possible. Verify this exact APK is installed before recording results. Left stick navigates hexes; right stick browses units; shoulders cycle legal melee approaches; A confirms; X/Y use Defend/Wait; Back toggles Auto. Keep a save suitable for regression checks.
limitations: Advanced spell and other interfaces may use the existing cursor fallback. Record unavailable scenarios as Blocked with notes. Automated CI success does not establish hardware acceptance. The companion never authorizes promotion or merging.

checks.title: Battle navigation and target previews
checks.steps: Navigate every edge, diagonal and obstacle with the left stick. Browse friendly/enemy and two-wide units with the right stick. Release controls to neutral and check repeat timing.
checks.expected: Targets and previews remain visible and accurate; dead zone and repeat behavior are usable; no stuck movement occurs.

checks.title: Movement, attacks and all legal melee sides
checks.steps: Use A for legal movement, melee and ranged attacks. Attack from both sides and confirm the default approach follows the actor. Cycle every legal approach with both shoulders, including two-wide top/bottom approaches. Try invalid destinations, rapid/double A and changing targets while A is held. Compare X/Y Defend/Wait with the lower controls.
checks.expected: Legal actions execute once. Default and shoulder-selected approaches agree with the preview. Invalid/repeated input submits no unintended action; controls match native availability.

checks.title: Auto, spells, tactics and confirmations
checks.steps: Start/stop Auto using Back and the lower controls. Exercise spellbook, targeted/multi-target spells, cancellation, creature abilities, tactics move/next/end, options and retreat/surrender confirmations. Use cursor fallback for advanced interfaces.
checks.expected: Actions and cancellation complete normally. Lower controls reflect targeting, AI and pending actions without stale or duplicate requests.

checks.title: Modal and battle-result restoration
checks.steps: Open/dismiss inspect, modal, spellbook and result windows. Finish battle and return to Adventure. Hold A/B/shoulders/sticks across turns, modals, action completion and result dismissal.
checks.expected: No held-release action leaks into a new window. Current targeting and input recover; dismissed windows leave no residual image or input.

checks.title: Controller reconnect, remap and mixed input
checks.steps: Disconnect/reconnect and remap the controller while held, then release to neutral. Switch among upper touch, mouse and controller. Check native and cursor modes.
checks.expected: No connection/remap action fires unexpectedly. Pointer and preview recover, with correct upper focus and usable input.

checks.title: Lower display and background/resume
checks.steps: Toggle or disconnect/reconnect the lower display and background/resume with input held. Re-enter battle and leave it again.
checks.expected: One current lower deck returns; neutral/release recovery, upper focus and independent gestures work. No duplicate actions or residual navigation overlay remains.

checks.title: Adventure, Hero/Town and Battle regressions
checks.steps: Recheck Adventure navigation, Hero/Town interactions and Battle Quick Controls. Test lower-disabled/single-screen behavior; record non-Thor coverage or its unavailability separately.
checks.expected: Existing gameplay and touch/controller behavior remain usable. Record each failure and unavailable scenario against this exact build.

checks.title: Verified installation and saved validation
checks.steps: In the helper, verify the selected candidate's checksum, install it using Android's confirmation, launch VCMI, and return to a checklist. Save a result and notes, close/reopen the helper and reboot when convenient. Copy/share the report. On a different candidate, check that results start independently.
checks.expected: Installed identity is confirmed from APK bytes. Results and notes survive restart/reboot and remain tied to the correct candidate. An uninstalled or different APK cannot receive confirmed test results. The report contains exact build identity, results and notes.
